blocks.text: Elevating the art of traditional cottage styling, the Realyn chairside end table is sure to serve you beautifully for years to come. Antiqued two-tone aesthetic blends a chipped white with a distressed wood finished top for added charm. Cabinet door features inset mirror with filigree moulding for a fanciful twist.

items.label: CHAIR SIDE END TABLE
items.value: Cottage lovers, rejoice—this table serves up style with a chipped white finish and inset mirror on the door that exudes pure elegance. You'll enjoy its shapely, refined form

items.label: BEAUTIFULLY CRAFTED
items.value: Accent table is made of veneers, wood and engineered wood with cast resin components. Designed with an inset mirror cabinet door with filigree moulding and a fixed shelf

items.label: COTTAGE QUAINT
items.value: The two tone finish gives plenty of chic panache in your living room. Plus, the extra shelf inside the cabinet door provides storage for decor accents, an indoor plant or a lamp

items.label: SMALL SPACE SOLUTION
items.value: Measuring 26" W x 26" D x 26" H, this side table looks great set by a living room sofa or in narrow spaces such as an entryway or hallway

items.label: ASSEMBLY REQUIRED
items.value: Easy-to-follow instructions, hardware and tools included
